issues: 字体回退到 Courier 打字机衬线，标签 SERIES_A / GROUP_C 是调试占位词
背景死黑 #0a0a0c、图表直接漂在屏幕上，没有面板、坐标与层次
斜纹用整条尺寸的 repeating-gradient，条伸长时斜纹相位随宽度变化而爬动
实心柱是平涂渐变，且渐变随单条宽度压缩，短条和长条颜色逻辑不一致
微颤 sin 在 t=0.85 后保持满幅不收，尾帧一直在抖；表头 TOTAL 875K / AVG 1.02M 数据自相矛盾
changes: 图表收进深色面板（0.25 设计 px 发丝线 + 顶部内高光 + 两层软阴影），背景换柔光暗场 + 暗角 + 颗粒，加 0–400K 刻度网格
斜纹改为 6px 平铺、锚在条左端，伸长期前沿一根亮线；生长错峰 0.055→0.035 递减、强 ease-out(0.16,1,0.3,1)
实心层加顶部受光 / 底部压暗 / 贴底辉光，渐变按满幅柱区铺；蜕变用对称 in-out 交叉淡化，中段亮度 1.18→1 落定
柱端数值随蜕变从 0 滚到终值（tabular-nums），标签颜色平滑退一档而非硬切
微颤改为指数衰减，t≈0.9 前归零尾帧静止；表头换成标题 + LIVE 胶囊（一次脉冲）+ 自洽的 1.45M total · 290K avg，三段错峰滑入
系统字体栈 + raster=zoom 按目标尺寸光栅化，标签换成 Organic / Direct / Referral / Paid / Email
issuesEn: Font fell back to Courier typewriter serif; labels SERIES_A / GROUP_C were debug placeholders
Dead black background with the chart floating on screen: no panel, no axis, no depth
Hatching used a box-sized repeating gradient, so the stripes crawled as the bars grew
Solid bars were flat gradients compressed per bar, so short and long bars had inconsistent colour logic
The sine wiggle stayed at full amplitude after t=0.85 so the end frame kept shaking; header TOTAL 875K / AVG 1.02M was self-contradictory
changesEn: Chart now sits in a dark panel (hairline border, top inner highlight, two-layer soft shadow) on a soft-lit dark backdrop with vignette and grain, plus a 0–400K gridline axis
Hatching is a 6px tile anchored to the bar origin with a bright leading edge while growing; grow stagger tightens 0.055→0.035 with a strong ease-out (0.16,1,0.3,1)
Solid layer gains top light, bottom shade and an under-glow, gradient spans the full track; the morph is a symmetric in-out crossfade with a 1.18→1 brightness settle
Bar-end values roll from 0 to final during the morph (tabular-nums); labels dim smoothly instead of hard switching
Wiggle now decays exponentially to zero by t≈0.9 so the end frame is still; header is a title + LIVE pill (single pulse) + consistent 1.45M total · 290K avg, staggered in
System font stack with raster=zoom for crisp glyphs; labels renamed to Organic / Direct / Referral / Paid / Email
